mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emergency_handle_log (call_id, admin_id, content, create_time) VALUES (#{callId}, #{adminId}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.call_id AS callId, l.admin_id AS adminId, a.name AS adminName, l.content, DATE_FORMAT(l.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime FROM emergency_handle_log l LEFT JOIN admin_info a ON a.id = l.admin_id WHERE l.call_id = #{callId} ORDER BY l.create_time ASC, l.id ASC
